description: Planning fixture for the future renderer implementation slices. Maps each implementation slice (007H-1 through 007H-9) to its goal, allowed files, disallowed files, required tests, acceptance criteria, no-runtime assertions, rollback point, and merge prerequisite. This is a spec-only fixture; no React, no IPC, no runtime.

slices.name: GateCard implementation
slices.goal: Implement KnowledgeFlushGateCard as a leaf presentational component. Render 3 status states (pass/warn/fail) for one of 5 gates. No internal state. No props mutation.
allowed_files: src/renderer/src/components/Flush/FlushGateCard.module.css (optional, if not using Tailwind utility classes)
required_tests: component test: 5 gate types × 3 status (pass/warn/fail) snapshot
fixture test: mount with 3 ui-confirmation fixtures, render no forbidden copy
acceptance_criteria: 5 gate types render distinctly (user_confirmation / source_fidelity / bucket_semantics / roadmap_guard / secret_guard)
3 status states have distinct visual treatment (pass / warn / fail)
fail component propagates 'gate failed' affordance to parent (via aria-live=assertive)
no forbidden copy in rendered text (scanForbiddenFlushUiCopy ok=true)
no IPC / preload / fetch / runtime calls
forbidden_copy_assertions: no '已保存' / '写入成功' / '确认后将写入'
no 'saved successfully' / 'will be written after confirm'
no_runtime_assertions: no window.hermesAPI.knowledgeIngest / knowledgeSearch / runPlaybook / sendMessage / triggerCronJob / gateway*
no Node-only import (fs / child_process / path in renderer)
slices.rollback_point: git revert 007H-1 PR; no shared helper changes; no preload changes; safe to revert at any time

slices.name: RiskCard implementation
slices.goal: Implement KnowledgeFlushRiskCard as a leaf presentational component. Render 1 of 6 risk categories with severity badge. No internal state.
required_tests: component test: severity visual badge (info / warn / block)
acceptance_criteria: 6 risk categories render distinctly (roadmap_mutation / stale_source_promotion / secret_leak / vault_authority_claim / external_instruction_authority / live_flush_pending_hardening)
live_flush_pending_hardening is always info severity
block severity triggers acknowledgement affordance
no forbidden copy
no IPC / preload / fetch / runtime calls
forbidden_copy_assertions: no overpromise wording (已保存 / saved / written)

slices.name: DraftPreview implementation
slices.goal: Implement KnowledgeFlushDraftPreview as a composed panel. Renders title / summary / local_findings / web_findings / stale_sources / provenance / trust_level / retrieval_keywords via projectRequestToSummary.
required_tests: no forbidden copy in rendered text
acceptance_criteria: renders title / summary / primary source / counts / keywords
renders local_findings / web_findings / stale_sources (3 sections, stale never hidden)
renders provenance block (source_type / source_uri / fetched_at / trust_level / safe_to_use_as_instruction)
no forbidden copy
no_runtime_assertions: does not mutate request prop (deep-clone if needed)

slices.name: SourceFidelityPanel implementation
slices.goal: Implement KnowledgeFlushSourceFidelityPanel. Renders 3 lists (local_findings / web_findings / stale_sources) with exact source_uri / fetched_at preservation.
required_tests: vault source_type only for vault:// URI
acceptance_criteria: source_uri verbatim (no rewrite, no drift)
fetched_at verbatim (no rewrite, no drift)
vault source_type only for vault:// URI (HARD FAIL on mismatch)
HARD FAIL propagates blocking_issue_count > 0

slices.name: BucketSemanticsPanel implementation
slices.goal: Implement KnowledgeFlushBucketSemanticsPanel. Renders 3 bucket sections (local_known / newly_found / historical_only) with per-check status badge.
required_tests: local_plan in newly_found surfaces as soft_fail highlight
do_not_use_as_current_truth=true in newly_found surfaces as hard_fail highlight
acceptance_criteria: 3 bucket sections render (local_known / newly_found / historical_only)
misplacement surfaces as visible issue badge
no forbidden copy

slices.name: FooterActions implementation
slices.goal: Implement KnowledgeFlushFooterActions. Holds phrase input / risks checkbox / Confirm Flush / Reject / Close. Wires dispatch + computeConfirmButtonEnabled.
required_tests: 3-gate enablement: phase=open + 0 blocking + acked + phrase match
disabled_reason renders for awaiting_phrase / awaiting_risks_ack / blocked_by_validation
Reject / Cancel available in every state
acceptance_criteria: Confirm Flush disabled until 3-gate enablement met
disabled_reason visible
Reject / Cancel always in tab order
Copy draft json non-mutating
forbidden_copy_assertions: no '已保存' / '写入成功' / '确认后将写入' / 'saved successfully' / 'will be written after confirm'
no_runtime_assertions: approve action only dispatches reducer; never triggers IPC

slices.name: ConfirmationPanel composition
slices.goal: Implement KnowledgeFlushConfirmationPanel. Top-level container with useReducer(reduceConfirmation, INITIAL_CONFIRMATION_STATE). Composes all 6 prior components. Manages 3-step wizard flow.
allowed_files: src/renderer/src/screens/Knowledge/Knowledge.tsx (add knowledgeFlushConfirm tab only, no other behavior change)
acceptance_criteria: 3-step flow renders (review_request / review_evidence / review_risks)
state badge visible (pending_live_flush / live adapter approval pending)
safety footer visible (runtime_flush_allowed = false · live adapter not approved · confirmation only makes the draft eligible)
approve transitions state but does not trigger IPC
approved phase shows 'Awaiting live flush adapter approval' label
no forbidden copy
forbidden_copy_assertions: no '已保存' / '写入成功' / '确认后将写入' / 'saved successfully' / 'will be written after confirm'
no_runtime_assertions: no IPC / fetch / runtime / knowledgeIngest / knowledgeSearch / gateway
Knowledge.tsx integration: only adds knowledgeFlushConfirm tab; no other behavior change; no IPC wiring
slices.rollback_point: git revert 007H-7 PR; revert Knowledge.tsx tab addition
merge_prerequisite: no IPC / preload diff (other than Knowledge.tsx tab addition, which is a UI integration)

allowed_files: (deferred; will be specified in a future slice)
disallowed_files: (deferred; will be specified in a future slice)
required_tests: screenshot diff against expected golden state
forbidden copy scanner over rendered text
acceptance_criteria: 3 screenshots captured to .wolf/designqc-captures/knowledge-flush-{draft-ready,blocked,pending}.png
no visual regression vs expected state

slices.name: Final renderer closeout
slices.goal: Final closeout for the renderer implementation phase. Records final test pyramid, final fixture inventory, final forbidden copy gate, and declares the renderer implementation phase complete.
acceptance_criteria: all 7 component tests + 3 fixture mounts PASS
all 15 no-runtime acceptance criteria (007F § 12) PASS
no IPC / preload / runtime / HCC / cron / WeChat / iLink / write / live adapter touch
